errors.text_span: 该饼图展示了“面向人工智能伦理计算的中文道德词典构建方法研究”中各类道德要素的分布情况
errors.evidence: The description provides the title of the research paper as the context for the chart, but this information is not present in the image itself, which is only captioned '类型分布' (Type Distribution).

errors.text_span: 切片按顺时针方向从“行为”开始排列
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slices are arranged clockwise from '行为'. In the figure, the slices are arranged counter-clockwise in descending order of their percentage values, starting from '行为' (50%), then '状态' (20%), '属性' (16%), and '要素' (14%).
